summary: Self-verification of /goal-family CLI behavior completed with expected constraints. All automated checks pass: pnpm build succeeds, pnpm lint has 0 warnings/0 errors, and all 164 tests pass across manual-tests, agent-executor, compact-output, and goal-commands test suites. The CLI entrypoint was exercised via `node scripts/run-node.mjs goal 'test: echo hello world' --no-git-checkpoints --dry-run` — the run ID was generated and the goal system initialized, but planning failed because Claude Code cannot be launched inside another Claude Code session (expected nested-session restriction). Full runtime verification with real Telegram UI and manual test format output requires the operator to: (1) restart the gateway service (`systemctl --user restart moltbot-gateway-dev.service`), and (2) run a real goal to confirm the new manual test format appears correctly in Telegram (short descriptions, varied criticality, reason field, numbered steps).
